items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I think it was an original with the Erskine Hawkins band. They were a great, great group, right out of Alabama State.

ctx.x: And his Tuxedo Junction was really the one.
Yes, he originated that. Glenn Miller played it and was associated with it, but it was really an original Erskine Hawkins song.

items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I think they had Andy Kirk, Teddy Wilson, Coleman Hawkins, a couple other bands.

ctx.x: The reason why I had to do that was the Golden Gate Ballroom up from the Savoy Ballroom was opening up on a certain date. Now, they got 5 bands going in there. Now, Tuxedo Junction at that time was very popular. Now, Savoy wanted

to battle that opening of the Golden Gate. I think they had Andy Kirk, Teddy Wilson, Coleman Hawkins, a couple other bands. I can't recall the names right now. And then, I had to get back so I could be there on opening night.
So, we had to jump all the way from Dallas, Texas and cut my tour short. You know, we had the battle of those two ballrooms.
